subject: smooth lines in my sctter plot

messages.author: 8f74537ffbb949a6
messages.subject: smooth lines in my sctter plot
parts:
Hi,
I am a real new user of R
I have learnt how to make scatter plots in nlme,
and I am trying to predict diameter growth as with the following codes,

The question is it possible to make points with lines that will show species behaviour in the plot?

plot(sub1sp$d.x,sub1sp$id,main="diameter increment")
points(mset$d.x,predict(mm1,level=0),col="red")
points(mset$d.x,mset$id,pch=".",cex=4,col=mset$sp)

Thanks if my question is understood.

messages.author: 3cf85f593dde4722
messages.subject: Re: smooth lines in my sctter plot
parts:
You are using base graphics (the functions plot, points, lines...). This mailing list is for the users of the package ggplot2, an alternative way to plot data in R. I suggest you look for and follow some tutorial before getting heads first into this.

Have fun with R.
Adriano Fantini
